name: Bull Rush
description: A lowered-shoulder charge learned from the Labyrinth's warden. Deals heavy physical damage scaling with STR.
flavor_text: Asterion always turned left. You never do.

name: Spectral Ward
description: A permanent ward of cold light, like armor, that turns aside blows from the living and the dead.
flavor_text: The ghosts of Ashgrove taught you how to not be there when the blow lands.

name: Stormcall
description: Call down a bolt from a storm you carry inside you. Arcane damage scaling with INT.
flavor_text: The Thunderbird's storm, bottled and uncorked.

name: Rime Lance
description: A spear of everfrost, hurled. Ice damage scaling with INT.
flavor_text: Cold that the kings in the tomb would recognise.

name: Ember Rebirth
description: When your life burns low, a phoenix ember in your chest flares and heals you. Triggers on low HP.
flavor_text: Phoenixes do not die. They wait.

name: Brannoc's Mark
description: Old Brannoc's tracking and his eye for the weak spot: a lasting edge in every fight against beasts and monsters.
flavor_text: Every monster has a soft place. You know where to look.

name: Clockwork Precision
description: Odo's gear-timed footwork: your strikes land with mechanical precision for bonus damage on every hit.

name: Void Step
description: Evasion learned from the Hollow of Unmaking: for an instant, you are not where you were.

name: Gorgon's Gaze
description: A borrowed glance from Euryale's line. Stony damage scaling with WIS that leaves the target sluggish.

name: Venom Strike
description: Mabb's trick with hive venom on the blade: every basic attack carries bonus damage.
flavor_text: It doesn't need to be a big cut.
